name: programming-ime-vscode-bridge
description: Seven-language local suggestions, per-hunk reviewed F1 AI edits and BYOK AI for Programming IME. The editor-side bridge of the system IME design; not a TSF input method.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace AI is disabled; local candidates keep working.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Whole-file F1 edits need a real file or untitled buffer.

programmingIme.enabled.description: Enable candidates and the F1 binding. While off, F1 keeps opening the Command Palette.

programmingIme.uiLocale.description: UI language of Programming IME. Independent of the Windows input language and of the programming profile.

programmingIme.suggestMode.description: auto: inline suggestions while typing. explicit: only when you press Ctrl+Alt+Space.

programmingIme.pinnedCandidates.description: Candidate ids that always rank first.

programmingIme.f1Binding.description: Key that opens the F1 AI edit panel when Programming IME is enabled. Use shift+f1 or none to keep F1 for the Command Palette.

programmingIme.f1ExcludedLanguages.description: Language ids in which the F1 binding is never taken over.

programmingIme.coreExecutable.description: Absolute path of a trusted, locally built pime-core executable (protocol 0.2). Empty uses the built-in JavaScript engine.

programmingIme.aiEnabled.description: Master switch. While off, no AI request is ever sent, whatever else is configured.

programmingIme.realtimeAI.description: Send authorised nearby code to the realtime provider for suggestions. Needs aiEnabled and a workspace authorisation.

programmingIme.providers.description: Provider profiles: id -> {api, endpoint}. api is openai-responses, openai-chat or anthropic-messages. Keys are stored in SecretStorage, never here.

programmingIme.scenarios.description: Independent settings for realtime, f1Full and f1Insert: provider, model, effort, effortCapability, maxOutputTokens, timeoutMs.

programmingIme.budget.description: {maxRequests, maxTokens, pricePer1kTokens}. 0 means unlimited. When reached, AI stops; local input is unaffected.
